line_items.work_text: Sensitization and Training on Incident Response System (IRS) in newly created districts of Assam followed by Mock Exercise based on the IRS principal

Strengthening of Ward Disaster Management Committees (WDMCs) and involving the urban and sub-urban populations of Assam in DM activities (243 wards in 23 nos. of Municipal Boards/ Town Committees under 12 districts)- 2 day in each ward
Emergency Management Exercise (EMEx) for HQs of 6th Scheduled districts i.e. Kokrajhar, Diphu and Haflong through DDMA in collaboration with 1st Bn. NDRF and SDRF/Fire & ES.- 4 days in each DDMA

narrative: Coordination of response and managing relief operation.
